name: EXM_CC_ACCEPTORS
description: This table contains the merchants who provide Level 3 detail transactions and the average time for providing the details.

columns.name: CARD_ACCEPTOR_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a merchant providing detail transactions.

columns.name: CARD_PROGRAM_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the corporate card program for which the merchant provides detail transactions.

columns.name: COMPANY_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the company account.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Name of the merchant that accepted the corporate card for a transaction.

columns.name: STREET_ADDRESS
columns.description: Address of the merchant that accepted the corporate card for a transaction.

columns.name: CITY
columns.description: City where the merchant is located.

columns.name: STATE_PROVINCE
columns.description: Credit card acceptor state or province.

columns.name: POSTAL_CODE
columns.description: Postal code for the merchant's location.

columns.name: COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Country of the merchant.

columns.name: BUSINESS_CODE
columns.description: Business code assigned to the merchant.

columns.name: TAXPAYER_NUMBER
columns.description: Tax payer number of the merchant.

columns.name: VAT_NUMBER
columns.description: VAT registration number of the merchant.

columns.name: DUNS_NUMBER
columns.description: Dun and Bradstreet number of the merchant.

columns.name: DETAIL_WAITING_DURATION
columns.description: Average number of days the merchant takes to provide Level 3 details for corporate card transactions.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
